# canary proposals queue --help · COLUMNS=80 · colour off
canary proposals queue — Prepare, arm, cancel or read an owner-approved order
queue

Usage: canary proposals queue <action> [flags]

Actions
  prepare           Prepare a private queued-order handoff; no submission
  arm               Arm an approved queued order from standard input
  cancel            Cancel a queued authorisation
  list              Read queued authorisations
  status            Read one queued authorisation

Run canary proposals queue <action> --help for syntax and flags.
